note: No measurements have been performed. All eligibility and support fields are design-time predictions derived from static code analysis and read-only database inspection.
description: Phase 7 targeted corpus expansion — designed to give Policies B and C a genuine opportunity to use historical candidate-key evidence on previously unseen query templates.

proposed_cases.canonical_template: select * from orders where total_amount > ? and status = ?
proposed_cases.sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE total_amount > 200.00 AND status = 'PENDING';
proposed_cases.b_c_exerciseable_reason: orders:btree:total_amount has 3 TRAIN matches (IDs 4,5,6); baseline orders:btree:total_amount,status has 0 TRAIN matches. B/C expected to boost (total_amount) over composite.
proposed_cases.rationale: Primary exerciseable case: TRAIN-matched single-col candidate (total_amount) competes against TRAIN-unmatched composite baseline. Genuine opportunity for B/C to diverge from A.

proposed_cases.canonical_template: select * from orders where total_amount > ? and status = ?
proposed_cases.sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE total_amount > 350.00 AND status = 'SHIPPED';
proposed_cases.b_c_exerciseable_reason: Same TRAIN evidence as TP-A-01 but different parameter values (higher threshold, different status). Tests policy consistency across parameter variation within the same template.
proposed_cases.rationale: Within-template variation for TP-A; tests policy consistency across different parameter selectivities.

proposed_cases.canonical_template: select * from orders where total_amount > ? and status = ?
proposed_cases.sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE total_amount > 150.00 AND status = 'COMPLETED';
proposed_cases.b_c_exerciseable_reason: Lower total_amount threshold (>150) increases selectivity. Tests whether higher row density affects planner cost estimates and thus candidate scoring.
proposed_cases.rationale: Lower threshold variant; higher row selectivity may reduce measured ΔT% and tests regime where composite might outperform single-col.

proposed_cases.canonical_template: select * from orders where status = ? and total_amount > ?
proposed_cases.sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'CANCELLED' AND total_amount > 250.00;
proposed_cases.b_c_exerciseable_reason: Identical TRAIN evidence as TP-A (total_amount matches IDs 4,5,6) but different template hash. Tests whether B/C behave consistently with the same evidence across differently-ordered predicates.
proposed_cases.rationale: Different template (status predicate first) but same candidate pool. Tests cross-template consistency of outcome-aware ranking.

proposed_cases.canonical_template: select * from orders where status = ? and total_amount > ?
proposed_cases.sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND total_amount > 100.00;
proposed_cases.b_c_exerciseable_reason: Very low threshold (>100) returns ~80% of orders. Tests edge case where neither candidate may show strong improvement, but B/C still have TRAIN evidence to apply.
proposed_cases.rationale: Low selectivity edge case for TP-D. At this threshold planner may prefer sequential scan; HypoPG may reject both candidates. Included to test fail-closed behavior.

proposed_cases.canonical_template: select * from orders where order_date >= ? and total_amount > ?
proposed_cases.sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-02-15' AND total_amount > 200.00;

predicted_candidate_pool.predicted_hypopg_eligible: uncertain — existing idx_orders_order_date may interact with composite

predicted_candidate_pool.predicted_safety_eligible: likely blocked by equivalent index detection

proposed_cases.b_c_exerciseable: conditional — only if order_date candidates survive HypoPG and safety
proposed_cases.b_c_exerciseable_reason: If order_date candidates are rejected by existing-index detection or HypoPG NO_IMPROVEMENT, the eligible pool reduces to (total_amount) only — single candidate, trivial agreement.
proposed_cases.rationale: Supplementary case. Included to explore whether the existing order_date index causes Phase 1 to reduce candidate pool. Acts as a natural stress test of the SafetyAssessor / HypoPG rejection path.

excluded_templates.exclusion_reason: Single column, single candidate. No TRAIN key match (TRAIN covers orders only). Guaranteed B/C fallback. No experiment value.

excluded_templates.canonical: select * from order_items where product_id = ? and quantity > ?
excluded_templates.exclusion_reason: No TRAIN key matches (TRAIN is orders-only). idx_order_items_product_id already exists and will block product_id single-col candidate. Remaining quantity candidate also has no TRAIN match. Guaranteed B/C fallback.
